gap: Exact duration of the jump experience not stated
blurb: Guests experience a tandem skydive from 10,000 feet with a USPA certified instructor. The jump includes a 15-minute training, freefall up to 45 seconds at over 120 mph, and a 5-minute parachute glide with views of the Mississippi River and St. Louis Arch. Optional photo and video packages are available.
extraNote: Deposits are non-refundable but transferable and valid for one calendar year · Booking fees are non-refundable · Rescheduling allowed with 14 days notice or if cancelled due to weather · Weather dependent activity, delays possible · Tipping instructors is not expected but appreciated · Skydive St. Louis dropzone, 36 miles south of St. Louis
